_comment: Copy this file to config.json (gitignored, never committed) and edit it for your setup. See README.md for the full field reference.
title: NETOPS // HOMELAB DASHBOARD

power._comment: Optional. Without this key, the electricity cost estimate auto-detects a rough country-average rate from the system timezone and shows an UNCONFIRMED TARIFF warning on the board. Set your real rate here (from your actual bill) to silence that warning and get an accurate figure.

arr._comment: Optional. Adds a 'library' button that lists what Sonarr/Radarr have on disk, largest first, and deletes an item plus its files AND its qBittorrent torrent (so hardlinked downloads actually free the space). Omit this key and the button never appears. Get each api_key from that app's Settings -> General -> Security. Deleting is restricted to local-network requests; browsing works anywhere.
